rawContent: It's been 7 years of cover-up & obstruction by City officials. With a complete lack of transparency especially surrounding the lack of discipline related to misconduct by officers other than Daniel Pantaleo. #EricGarner #BlackLivesMatter #Carrvsdeblasio

I am concerned the [#Carrvsdeblasio] inquiry will end up structured in a way that insulates higher-ups [NYC officials] who are involved in investigations & disciplinary decisions relevant to #EricGarner's killing. - Attorney @gideonoliver #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/GdulgeeNld

We forever say #EricGarner's name & lift up his life! Today, 9/15, is Eric's 51st birthday. We celebrate him & stand with his family, who have been fighting for 7+ years to hold all #NYPD who killed him & NYPD and City officials who covered it up accountable. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/HzYUxWqzeb

#FlashbackFriday: this week @GVSHP reminded us that #NYPD fatally beat aspiring artist & model Michael Stewart in the #EastVillage on 9/15/83. #BlackLivesMatter

"Our family’s suffering has been unbearable for the past two years."
